items.title: Complicated urinary tract infections managed in a hospital-at-home programme – Full Text
items.summary: "In this single-centre, uncontrolled descriptive cohort, cUTI managed through HaH/OPAT was associated with high clinical cure and low unplanned transfer, despite a substantial burden of ESBL-producing organisms and other resistance-mechanism-positive isolates" Pelari-Mici et al (2026).

items.title: Management of home medical equipment – Full Text
items.summary: "This study aims to elucidate the relationship between equipment malfunctions and management practices at visiting nursing stations (stations), as well as to assess the perceived need for CEs" Hamasaka et al (2026).

items.title: Intradialytic parenteral nutrition – Full Text
items.summary: "Intradialytic parenteral nutrition (IDPN) is recommended for patients on hemodialysis (HD) with protein-energy wasting (PEW) who cannot meet nutritional needs through oral or enteral intake" Sabatino et al (2026).

items.title: Implementation of a pre-X-ray safety check in neonates – Full Text
items.summary: "A standard pre-x-ray checklist improved the diagnostic quality of films in a neonatal unit when combined with increased provider presence during the x-ray procedure and staff education" Armbruster et al (2026).

items.title: Assessment of venipuncture performance – Full Text
items.summary: "This study compares performance scores obtained through real-time on-site observation, independent video assessment, and collaborative video assessment of venipuncture performance" Yi et al (2026).

items.title: Economic impact of alcohol-impregnated disinfecting caps on CLABSI rates
items.summary: "Implementation of 70% isopropyl alcohol-impregnated disinfecting caps resulted in a substantial clinical reduction in ambulatory CLABSI incidence and yielded significant cost savings in this high-risk population" Devrim et al (2026).
